subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR's downstream diagnostic stuck-recovery classification be accepted now, or should it wait for the adjacent timeout-budget recovery work?
rationale: The code looks coherent and source-backed, but the replay/fallback boundary can affect session state, retry safety, and availability in ways automated review should not own without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after owner review
options.body: Land this PR after the assigned session-state owner explicitly accepts the model-call, side-effecting tool, and stale recovery semantics while keeping timeout-budget work adjacent.

options.title: Wait for timeout-budget work
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98580 settles when recovery should fire, then re-review the combined behavior.

options.title: Ask for a narrower split
options.body: Request a smaller branch that only preserves `stuck_recovery` propagation first, leaving model/tool replay classification for a separate maintainer-owned patch.

recommendation.title: Accept after owner review
recommendation.body: Land this PR after the assigned session-state owner explicitly accepts the model-call, side-effecting tool, and stale recovery semantics while keeping timeout-budget work adjacent.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already gave the central replay-safety guidance that this branch attempts to satisfy.
